title: Support in the pause between routines

captions.emotions: Experiencing a pause and another perspective

meaning: Your domestic support helps a transition when ending the old leaves help available and the pause need not be lived through in complete uncertainty.
text: When an earlier domestic method stops fitting, you may want to make room for another quickly. The Star in the physical position of Muladhara sustains hope through practical participation. Death in energy risks accelerating an ending beyond what present conditions allow. The Hanged Man in emotions experiences a pause and the need for another perspective. A gap appears: the old is closed, the new is not understood, and both must find support in this pause where familiar help is temporarily unavailable.

For example, you abandon previous storage arrangements and immediately dismantle every shelf. The new method still needs thought, however, and boxes fill the passage. Wanting to renew home makes it difficult to use peacefully. **A transition is easier when support is available before the final new answer.** A temporary place for essentials allows a pause without unnecessary crowding and another view of the task, without forcing both to choose the best option immediately.

The difficulty is treating a temporary arrangement as returning to the past and rejecting every interim help. The pause grows heavier, and the next decision has to be made from tiredness. Support grows when what has ended can be distinguished from what remains unknown. Giving up an old scheme need not mean abandoning every useful function it served; some support can remain while you find arrangements that fit.
